summary: Zhihu Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting a proposed subscription by a wholly owned subsidiary for a limited partnership interest in Tianjin Lisi Xingshen Equity Investment Partnership, an AI-focused blind-pool fund, with a RMB1.5 billion cash capital commitment payable under the Fund's capital call arrangements. The interest is expected to be no more than 30% post-closing, with no day-to-day management or investment decision rights. The subscription is a major transaction under HKEX Chapter 14 requiring EGM shareholder approval; a record date announcement for that meeting accompanies the release. Watch EGM approval, capital-call timing, and any valuation marks on the AI portfolio.
